extDescription.message: Export chat, group and channel history from Telegram Web (WebK) to JSON, HTML and Markdown.

notTelegram.message: Open a chat at web.telegram.org/k/ and click the extension again.

wrongVersion.message: Only the WebK version is supported. Switch to web.telegram.org/k/ in Telegram settings or open the link.

notReady.message: Telegram is still loading or you are not logged in. Please wait and try again.

noChat.message: Select a chat, group or channel in Telegram first.

connectError.message: Can't connect to the Telegram tab. Reload the page and try again.

maxFileSize.message: Max file size, MB (0 = no limit)

zipHint.message: With media or several formats the result is a ZIP archive.

status_done.message: Done! The file has been saved.

backgroundHint.message: You can close this window — the export continues while the Telegram tab stays open.
